extracted.intended_audience: Researchers and host organisations seeking Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) funding; prospective applicants and individuals looking for MSCA-funded job vacancies
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for prospective applicants and individuals on the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions programme: choosing the right MSCA funding type, preparing and submitting applications, and finding MSCA-funded job opportunities. Focused on navigating programme rules and where to find authoritative details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand the different types of MSCA funding supports
rubrics_metrics.description: Use this guide to learn about the different types of Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) funding supports and to learn which one is most suitable for you.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page is intended to help prospective applicants decide which MSCA action best fits their profile and needs. (No detailed list of action types is contained on this summary page; follow links to full guidance for specifics.)

rubrics_metrics.name: How to apply for Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions funding
rubrics_metrics.description: How to apply for Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Our detailed guides provide you with step-by-step details on applying for funding, from preparation to submission and beyond. Applicants should follow the stepwise instructions in the detailed guides when preparing proposals and submitting via the portal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Individuals can search for MSCA-funded project job vacancies
rubrics_metrics.description: Individuals can learn how to search for a job advertised by an MSCA funded project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site provides direction for researchers seeking positions on MSCA-funded projects; follow the advertised vacancy procedures and application instructions linked from the guides/portal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information on this page is a summary of the main rules and requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: The information provided in this guide is a summary of the main rules and requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This page is indicative only; it does not replace full regulatory texts. Use it for orientation but do not rely on it as the final determinant of eligibility or obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consult authoritative documents for full details
rubrics_metrics.description: For all the details about the MSCA actions and calls please refer to the Funding & Tenders Portal and the latest MSCA work programme and general annexes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must consult the Funding & Tenders Portal, the latest MSCA work programme and the Horizon Europe general annexes for definitive eligibility criteria, call texts, financial rules, deadlines, and other binding requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the currency of guidance / last update
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure you are using the most recent guidance and work programme versions; the page shows the last update date but applicants should verify there have been no subsequent changes in the portal or official documents.
